name: Rituals of Hashut
notes: Used by the Black Dwarf Sorcerer, who starts with two rituals: the Sacrificial Ritual plus one determined as usual from this list. The Sacrificial Ritual is printed as result 0 on the D6 table and is always known by the Sorcerer. Judgement call: Earthquake's Initiative test (roll equal to or under Initiative) is left as written.

spells.name: Sacrificial Ritual
spells.text: The Sorcerer must be in contact with an Engine of Chaos. Remove one captive model from the Engine and the starting warband's roster. He may sacrifice additional captives before rolling to lower the difficulty by 1 per sacrifice. The Sorcerer gains +D3 Experience.

spells.name: Spirit of Hashut
spells.text: Draw a line 18" from the Sorcerer. All models crossed by the line suffer one Strength 8 hit.

spells.name: Bellow of Doom
spells.text: All models in base contact with the Sorcerer must make an immediate Ld test or break from combat and run.

spells.name: Fumes of Azgorh
spells.text: Range 8", hits all models in its path on a roll of 7+. Each model hit suffers a Strength 8 hit, rolled to wound as normal. No armour saves allowed.

spells.name: Flickering Hide
spells.text: Cast on himself or any one model within 6". The flaming hide negates any one wound suffered on a roll of 7+. In hand-to-hand combat, any model that hits the flaming hide suffers one Strength 6 hit for each hit scored. Lasts until the beginning of the Sorcerer's next shooting phase.

spells.name: Lava Flow
spells.text: The Sorcerer may move 12" in any direction, even into combat, counting as a charge. He may only reappear on or below the ground.

spells.name: Earthquake
spells.text: All models within 3" of the Sorcerer, friend or foe, must roll equal to or under their Initiative or suffer D3 Strength 8 hits.
